items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 65:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the descent to the Klipot? It is known that ZA has no Mochin except by the souls that ascend to ZON as the aspect of MAN. As above, page 500, items 11 and 13. See there. It is also known that these MAN, for whose sake ZON ascended to Aba and Ima to receive new Mochin, must leave their root in ZON as an aspect of existence and standing, as above, page 513, item 39. For the Rav says there that because of the breaking of the vessels of ZON, their MAN, which they had left in Aba and Ima as an aspect of existence and standing, was nullified, and then the Mochin of Aba and Ima were also nullified and fell. See there. And therefore, also with the souls that raise MAN to ZON: if they spoil their actions, and their Mochin are blemished, they also cause the nullification of their MAN, which they had left in ZON as an aspect of existence and standing for their Mochin, and the Mochin of ZON that came out by the force of their raising of MAN are also nullified.
